name: initialContent
description: Initial markdown content. The editor is uncontrolled — subsequent prop changes do not replace the buffer.

name: onChange
description: Called with the full markdown buffer on every edit. Debounce at the call site if you plan to persist per keystroke.

name: readOnly
description: Disable editing while preserving syntax highlighting and theme.

name: className
description: Additional classes forwarded to the outer CodeMirror container.
